name: UniQueR Training Pipeline
definition: Spatial anchors: The other half of the queries are learnable spatial anchors initialized uniformly in $[-1.2, 1.2]^3$, scaled according to the predicted point range during training.
summary: UniQueR is a feedforward pipeline that generates sparse 3D Gaussians from multi-view images using learnable spatial anchors and held-out-view supervision to solve incomplete geometry reconstruction.
